template_data.headline_html: Five moves that break in without past performance.

items.title: Past performance is team-level
items.sub: Sub work counts — it builds the reference you'll bid with next time.

items.title: Your certs are real leverage
items.sub: 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB — primes need them to hit set-aside targets.

items.title: Get the agreement in writing
items.sub: Scope, labor split, work percentage on paper before the RFP drops.

items.title: Sources Sought finds your prime
items.sub: Primes scan them looking for capable subs to bring into their bid.

items.title: One sub win beats a cold solo bid
items.sub: That sub role builds exactly what a future prime application needs.
